title: RBI Revises Loan Recovery Rules

blocks.content: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) issued nine circulars on 6 August 2026 to create a unified framework called the Amendment Directions for loan recovery practices. The directions apply from 1 January 2027, after the original proposed date of 1 October 2026 was deferred to allow lenders time for transition.

items: The Reserve Bank of India was established in 1935 and nationalised in 1949.
The Indian Institute of Banking and Finance is a professional body linked with banking education and certification in India.
The Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, provides the legal basis for the RBI’s functioning.
Recovery agents are used by banks and financial institutions for collection of overdue loans and related borrower contact.
